app_type: Data-dense Financial Equity Research & Trade Monitoring SaaS Dashboard
emotional_archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO & SWISS FINANCIAL TERMINAL

core_principles: Tactical Financial Precision: Information density, zero fluff, instant scanability for active traders and equity analysts.
Transparent Scoring: 100-point Opportunity Score decomposed clearly into Technical (35), Fundamental (25), Sentiment (15), Sector (10), and Risk/Reward (15).
Institutional Visual Hierarchy: High-contrast data tables, crisp 1px borders, status-coded micro-badges, and mono-spaced price metrics.
Emotion-Free Trading Workflow: Research -> Setup -> Monitored Execution -> Journaling cycle that enforces strict risk management rules.
anti_patterns_to_avoid: NO generic centered marketing layouts or consumer-grade rounded bubbly buttons.
NO dark gradients that obscure text or chart legibility.
NO missing test IDs or unstyled HTML raw select elements.
NO full opacity blanket overlays on modals or drawers; use subtle backdrop blur (backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-900/80).

header_controls: Market Regime Badge (e.g. NIFTY Bullish / High Volatility)
Quick Ticker Search Bar (Cmd + K / Search Equity)
Persona Mode Switcher (Swing Trader / Breakout / Day Trader)
User Profile Avatar & Broker Status Pill

components.name: Technical Analysis
components.description: RSI momentum, MACD crossover, Moving average alignment (20/50/200 EMA), Chart breakouts

components.name: Fundamental Health
components.description: PE relative to sector, ROE %, Quarterly PAT growth %, Debt to Equity ratio

components.name: News & Sentiment
components.description: Institutional analyst upgrades, FII/DII accumulation, Media sentiment score

components.name: Sector Strength
components.description: Nifty Sector Index relative momentum (e.g. Nifty IT / Nifty Auto outperformance)

components.name: Risk / Reward Ratio
components.description: Tight stop loss placement with at least 1:2.0 to 1:3.5 target upside potential

components: Market Status Header with NIFTY 50 live metric (+0.72%), SENSEX (+0.65%), India VIX (13.40 -2.1%), Market Regime tag 'BULLISH MOMENTUM'
Opportunity Score Spotlight: Top 3 High-Conviction Equity Trade Ideas with 100-pt Score gauge
Active Monitored Ideas Summary widget with real-time target proximity bar
Recent Market Alerts feed (Breakout detected, Target 1 reached, Stop loss trailing alert)
Sector Heatmap Snapshot (Nifty IT +1.8%, Nifty Bank +0.4%, Nifty Auto +1.2%)

Equity Scanner Table: 25+ NIFTY 500 stocks with columns for Symbol, Sector, Market Cap, Price, Daily Change %, Technical Score, Fundamental Score, Sentiment Score, Sector Score, Risk/Reward Score, Total Score (Out of 100), and Action.
Interactive Filter Bar: Filter by Sector, Market Cap (Large, Mid, Small), Score threshold (>80, >70), Regime, RSI range.

Equity Detail Drawer / Modal: When clicking any stock, show complete deep-dive with Price Chart (Recharts area/candlestick), 100-point breakdown visual radar/bars, key valuation metrics (P/E, P/B, Debt/Equity, ROE, PAT Growth), Technical Signals table (RSI, MACD, 20/50/200 EMA), Analyst Sentiment & Recent News feed.
Trade Idea Cards with score badge (e.g., 88/100 EXCELLENT), Action Type (BUY / BREAKOUT / SWING), Entry Price (₹), Stop Loss (₹), Target 1 (₹), Target 2 (₹), Risk-Reward ratio (e.g. 1:2.85).
'Why This Idea?' section with 3 clear bullet points explaining research rationale.
Risk Warnings box (e.g. 'Key Earnings Release on Thursday', 'Tight stop loss required due to resistance at ₹2,850').
Primary Action: 'MONITOR THIS IDEA' button (instantly adds to My Monitoring page with feedback toast).
Secondary Action: 'VIEW FULL RESEARCH ANALYSIS' button (opens comprehensive research popover).
Tracked Ideas Table & Grid view.
Status Filters: All, Active Monitoring, Target 1 Hit, Target 2 Hit, Trailing Stop Active, Stop Loss Hit, Closed.
Proximity Gauge: Percentage progress bar showing how close current price is to Target 1 or Stop Loss.
Trailing Stop Loss Manager: Interactive button to adjust stop loss or activate automatic trailing stop alert.
Simulated P&L tracking based on suggested entry price vs current market price.

Trade Logging Form: Add manual or monitored trade log (Symbol, Entry Date, Exit Date, Entry Price, Exit Price, Quantity, Setup Category e.g. Breakout, Swing, Reversal, Trade Emotion/Mindset notes, Win/Loss flag).
Trade Metrics KPI Summary: Win Rate %, Total Simulated P&L (₹), Average Risk:Reward achieved, Profit Factor, Best Trade.
Equity Growth Curve Chart (Recharts line chart showing account growth over time).
Journal History Table with filtering by setup type and outcome.
Sector Performance Heatmap with interactive timeframes (1D, 1W, 1M, YTD).
Institutional Activity: FII / DII Net Flow breakdown in ₹ Crores (Daily & Monthly).
Advance / Decline Ratio Meter with Bull/Bear dominance percentage.
Market Breadth: Stocks above 50 EMA vs 200 EMA ratio.
Top Gainers & Top Losers table in NIFTY 50.
User Profile & Account Info
Risk Governance Parameters: Default Max Risk % per trade (e.g. 1.5%), Default Stop Loss % buffer, Max open positions limit.
Instant Notifications: Telegram Bot token setup, WhatsApp Alert webhook, In-app push notification toggles.
Broker API Integration: Read-only API key setup for Zerodha Kite, Groww, AngelOne with connection diagnostic test button.
Trading Persona Switcher: Switch UI presets for Swing Trader, Breakout Trader, or Position Investor.
F&O (Futures & Options) Feature Teaser & Interactive Option Chain Preview (NIFTY / BANKNIFTY Call/Put OI analysis, Max Pain calculation, PCR ratio teaser).
Early Access Request Form & Feature Poll (Vote for Strategy Builder, Option Greeks, Volatility Surface).

component_guidelines.buttons: Always use clear states. Primary buttons: bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white shadow-sm transition-all duration-150. Accent buttons for Monitor: bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500. Always include explicit data-testid attribute.
component_guidelines.tables: High density, hover rows with bg-slate-800/50, 1px border-slate-800, sticky headers with backdrop-blur-md, crisp font-mono for numeric columns (price, % change, scores).
component_guidelines.modals_and_drawers: Use Vaul / Radix Dialog with backdrop blur bg-slate-950/70 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl.
component_guidelines.toasts: Use Sonner for crisp financial notifications (e.g. 'Added TATAMOTORS to My Monitoring list', 'Trailing Stop Alert Triggered').

testing_requirements.rule: ALL interactive components MUST have explicit data-testid attributes formatted in kebab-case.
